description: Use this when you need the mortgage situations LenDb can match on. Returns every specialty with its slug, category (property type, loan program or borrower situation), label, one-line description and canonical_url: for example FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, DSCR, bank statement, ITIN, self-employed, first-time buyer, non-warrantable condo, multi-family 2-4 units and reverse mortgage. Also returns the supported languages as ISO 639-1 codes with names.
name: list_specialties
title: List mortgage specialties
